  2. Local RUNBOOK step only
     Keep PDF generation as a documented manual step
     in the team's local RUNBOOK, run by hand on
     someone's machine each quarter using existing
     local tooling. This avoids any changes to CI/CD
     infrastructure and keeps full manual control and
     visibility over each run, but it depends on a
     person remembering to follow the runbook and
     having the right local environment set up.
  3. Both: CI, plus a one-command local script
     Wire the PDF generation into the CI publish
     workflow for the automatic quarterly run, and
     also ship a standalone one-command local script
     that wraps the same logic for ad-hoc
     regeneration, debugging, or previewing changes
     before they hit CI. This gives redundancy and
     flexibility but means maintaining two invocation
     paths that must be kept in sync over time.
  4. Type something.
